notes: Save editor now does event tickets (Gen 3). In a Gen 3 game's Edit save dialog you can hand yourself the Eon Ticket (Latios/Latias), Mystic Ticket (Lugia & Ho-Oh), Aurora Ticket (Deoxys) and Old Sea Map (Mew) — Emerald gets all four, Ruby/Sapphire get Eon, FireRed/LeafGreen get Mystic + Aurora. It adds the key item and sets the enable flag, backing up your save first. TEST IT: reload in your emulator and check the ferry offers the trip — if it doesn't, tell me and I'll fix the flag (your .sav.bak backup is right next to the save).
